actions.MAIN: next grain window (Hann, half-sine, decay, decay-exp, gate)

ops_per_sample: ~35 flops per active voice (2 linear reads, 2 one-pole LP, window lerp, 2 pan MACs, pointer updates) x up to 24 voices (HX_GRAIN_VOICES) = ~850 at the cap, plus ~2 amortised spawn cost (450 spawns/s x ~200 incl. powf/expf/exp2f). Density is capped so voices stay <= 85 % of the pool; amplitude is normalised by 3/sqrt(overlap).
notes: Re-implementation of McCurdy DelayGrain.csd (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0). Stereo 2^17-sample rings (2.7 s, usable delay path <= ~2.7 s), 5 x 1025 window tables in the object. v1 preset default (GSize 14.8-84.8 ms, dens 500/s capped to ~240-430/s by the 24-voice cap, delay 19.4 ms..1.012 s exp, pan 1, amp spread 0.8, rev 0.7, filt 0.5, decay 0.536) + OCTUP 0.06. Window/distribution are action-selected, not params (12-param limit). Voice cap is the CPU lever.
